name: Social Security disability hearing waits and workloads by hearing office
description: How long Social Security disability claimants wait for a hearing before an administrative law judge, office by office, from the Social Security Administration's own public data files: the average months from the hearing request to the hearing for cases closed in the month, and each hearing office's fiscal-year-to-date receipts, dispositions, cases pending and average days from request to decision, with SSA's rank among 159 offices. Each record is one hearing office, with the state it sits in. Counts and averages only: no judge, claimant, lawyer or firm is named.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Social Security disability hearing waits and workloads by hearing office (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898096

distribution.name: disability-hearings.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: disability-hearings.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: disability-hearings
recordSet.description: The records of Social Security disability hearing waits and workloads by hearing office, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code of the office (ours, from its name); US for the national Special Review Cadre

field.name: jurisdictionName
field.description: Jurisdiction name

field.name: office
field.description: SSA's site code for the hearing office

field.name: officeName
field.description: The office's city or name as we print it

field.name: ssaName
field.description: The office name exactly as SSA prints it

field.name: region
field.description: SSA region number

field.name: waitMonths
field.description: Average months from the hearing request to the hearing, for cases closed in the month

field.name: aptDays
field.description: Average calendar days from the hearing request to the disposition, fiscal year to date

field.name: aptRank
field.description: SSA's rank of the office by average processing time (1 is fastest; ties share a rank)

field.name: aptOf
field.description: How many offices SSA ranked

field.name: receipts
field.description: Cases received in the fiscal year to date (negative when more cases were transferred out than came in)

field.name: dispositions
field.description: Cases disposed of in the fiscal year to date

field.name: pending
field.description: Cases pending at the end of the period

field.name: month
field.description: The month of the wait-time report (YYYY-MM)

field.name: fyThrough
field.description: The last day of the fiscal-year-to-date period

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: note
field.description: Caveats

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
